extracted text: The paper discusses AA2219 aluminum alloy in T87 temper condition. The T87 treatment is described as: solution treated at 807 K (534°C) for 1 hour + 7% stretched followed by aging at 436 K (163°C) for 24 hours. Tensile properties of the base metal (BM) AA2219-T87 are provided: UTS of 440 MPa, yield strength (0.2% YS) of 358 MPa, and elongation of 11.7%. Hardness value for the BM is reported as 128 Hv.
